3951-4452-5703-8095.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
3951-4452-5703-8095.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

3967-7084-7893.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

301-2744-7859.description:
Activate Goblin Chirurgeon by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Resolve the Goblin Chirurgeon ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3010-3259-4359.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3010-3259-4359.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Moonblade Shinobi, triggering Breath of Fury and Moonblade Shinobi.
Resolve the Moonblade Shinobi trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4885-7357.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4885-7357.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Pugnacious Pugilist as attackers.
Pugnacious Pugilist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1879-3259-3968.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-3259-3968.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Grave Titan as attackers.
Grave Titan triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

997-1734-4605-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Fiend Hunter and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-2841-4288-6157.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bant Panorama.
1479-2841-4288-6157.description:
Fetch a land using Bant Panorama.
When the fetched land enters, Sarinth Greatwurm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1978-4747-5056.notablePrerequisites: You had a creature with power 3 or greater enter the battlefield this turn.
1978-4747-5056.description:
Cause Alena to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Alena.
Repeat from step 2.

2060-3168-4770-6930.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1286-5256-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2921-5571-6331--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1495-4613-6774-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Loading Zone.
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2060-2919-3525-4597.description:
Activate Shu Farmer by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's ability by paying {U}, untapping Shu Farmer.
Repeat.

3609-4251-6750.notablePrerequisites: Inspirit has one or more charge counters on it.
3609-4251-6750.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Inspirit triggers, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Declare Godo as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your second combat phase. At the beginning of the combat phase, Inspirit triggers, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

3226-3693-4613.description:
Activate Blood Researcher by using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Blood Researcher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

4067-4851-6100-6281.description:
Activate Timeless Lotus by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Elvish Regrower.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Elvish Regrower that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Elvish Regrower token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Elvish Regrower from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Timeless Lotus.
Repeat.

1461-4050-4078-6097.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1461-4050-4078-6097.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurm tokens, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, putting Wurmcoil Engine from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Wurmcoil Engine enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wurmcoil Engine, adding {B}.
When Wurmcoil Engine dies, it triggers, creating two 3/3 Wurm artifact creature tokens.
When the Wurms enter the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurms, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

386-5610.easyPrerequisites: Glistening Oil attached to Hydra Omnivore.
386-5610.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block Hydra Omnivore.
You have a way to increase Hydra Omnivore's power by 2 or more, or each opponent has at least two poison counters.
386-5610.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Hydra Omnivore, causing them to get at least eight poison counters.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.
Hydra Omnivore triggers, causing each other opponent to get at least eight poison counters.
Each remaining opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.

1445-1913-2292-4871.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one artifact creature card in hand.
You have at least one artifact creature card in your graveyard.
1445-1913-2292-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding an artifact creature card, returning another artifact creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Imotekh triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a Necron Warrior.
When the Necron Warrior dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3336-3862-4050-4613.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have at least two cards in hand.
3336-3862-4050-4613.description:
Cast Orcish Bowmasters by paying {1}{B}.
When Orcish Bowmasters enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 0/0 Orc Army token if you do not control an Army, then putting a +1/+1 counter on an Army you control and dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the Orc Army using Whirlpool Warrior's ability by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing each player to shuffle their hand into their library, and causing each player to draw that many cards.
Orcish Bowmasters triggers for each card opponents draw this way.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a 0/0 Orc Army token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Orc Army, adding {1}.
Resolve the second Orcish Bowmaster trigger, creating a 0/0 Orc Army token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing 1 damage to any target.
Holding priority, repeat from step 3 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve the first remaining Orcish Bowmasters trigger, if applicable, creating a 0/0 Orc Army token if you do not control one, then putting a +1/+1 counter on an Army you control and dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 9 for each remaining trigger.

1409-1770-2208.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Charming Scoundrel.
1409-1770-2208.description:
Activate Charming Scoundrel by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Charming Scoundrel enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Charming Scoundrel.
Resolve both Charming Scoundrel triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

579-1185-1818-2308-2745.notablePrerequisites:
Prize Pig does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
579-1185-1818-2308-2745.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Healer of the Pride triggers, holding priority, activate Prize Pig by tapping it, adding {2}.
Resolve the Healer of the Pride trigger, causing you to gain 3 life due to Angel of Vitality.
Prize Pig and Trudge Garden trigger.
Resolve the Prize Pig trigger, putting three ribbon counters of Prize Pig, then removing all ribbon counters from Prize Pig and untapping it.
Resolve the Trudge Garden trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

222-1322-4050-5168.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Bloom Tender and Slimefoot and Squee, adding two mana of any color(s).
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning Slimefoot and Squee and Bloom Tender to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1824-4549-4924.manaNeeded: {B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1824-4549-4924.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed, or are venturing in, Tomb of Annihilation.
1824-4549-4924.description:
Cast Acererak either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {B} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Acererak enters, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Acererak, adding {B}.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

224-2532-3201-3470.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
224-2532-3201-3470.description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Arixmethes.
Put the token Arixmethes into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Arixmethes token dies, causing you to draw a card.
The Arixmethes token enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm and Lotus Cobra.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Jaxis.
Repeat.

914-3130-3584-4719.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least eight artifacts and/or enchantments.
You have cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
914-3130-3584-4719.description:
Cast Blue Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{U}{U}, targeting Anarchist.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers, creating at least one copy of Blue Sun's Twilight, targeting Dockside Extortionist and any other creature(s) as applicable.
Resolve the first copy of Blue Sun's Twilight, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist.
The Dockside Extortionist token enters the battlefield, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Resolve all remaining copies of Blue Sun's Twilight, as applicable.
Resolve the original Blue Sun's Twilight from step 1, creating a token copy of Anarchist.
The Anarchist token enters the battlefield, returning Blue Sun's Twilight from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target Anarchist and any other creature to get infinite copies of any creature on the battlefield.

1367-1692-3039-4450.description:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary copy of Carth the Lion with haste.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
After combat, activate Liliana Vess's second loyalty ability by removing zero loyalty counters from it, searching your library for Nexus of Fate, then shuffling your library and putting it on top.
Move to your next turn, drawing Nexus of Fate during your draw step.
Repeat each turn, adding additional loyalty counters during step 3 as you accumulate copies of Carth the Lion.

717-779-1573-3251.description:
Cast Psychic Miasma by paying {1}{B}, targeting yourself.
Recycle triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
If Dakmor Salvage is in your graveyard, instead replace drawing a card with milling two cards, and returning Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Psychic Miasma, discarding Dakmor Salvage and returning Psychic Miasma to your hand.
Bone Miser's second ability triggers, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
